# NETREX INC

> NETREX INC is a global digital agency headquartered in Dubai, UAE, with offices in New York, London, Berlin, Vancouver, Melbourne, Singapore, Riyadh, and Lahore. Since 2016 we have delivered web design & development, mobile apps, UI/UX, branding, digital marketing, e-commerce, AI agents & automation, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and cloud solutions to 500+ clients across 9 countries.

## What we do
- Web Design & Development (React, Next.js, WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, Elementor)
- Mobile App Development (iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native)
- UI/UX Design and Branding
- Digital Marketing (SEO, GEO, PPC, Social, Email, Content)
- E-Commerce (Shopify, WooCommerce, custom)
- AI Agent Integration & Custom Automation (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-source)
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) - get cited inside ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity
- Cloud Solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks)

## Why clients choose NETREX
- 9-country presence, 24/7 delivery
- ISO 27001 & ISO 27701 certified
- AWS Partner, Databricks Consulting Partner
- Clutch Champion 2024, Best of Clutch 2025, Clutch Global Fall 2024
- Top Software Developers 2020 (Clutch), Top Android Developers (TechReviewer)
- Average client ROI: 2x–5x within 6 months
- Multilingual delivery in 9 languages (EN, AR, ZH, FR, ES, DE, RU, PT, JA)
